parsed_json.sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_id AS indication_curie, di.efo_term AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 2 ORDER BY md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_id, di.efo_term, di.max_phase_for_ind
